title: Direct imaging furin-controlled intracellular condensation with two-photon laser microscope
protocol: Culture MDA-MB-468 human breast adenocarcinoma epithelial cells in Dulbecco’s modified eagle medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum in an incubator supplied with 5% carbon dioxide humidified air at 37 °C.
Seed the healthy cells on coverslips in each well of a 24-well plate at about 60% density, then incubate overnight.

Suck off the culture medium and add 500 μL DMEM containing 100 μM **2** or **2-Scr** by mixing 5 μL of PBS stock solution of **2** or **2-Scr** at 10 mM with 495 μL DMEM into different wells respectively, then incubate for 8 h.
Suck off the medium and wash the cells with PBS three times at room temperature.
Add 500 μL of 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS to each well to fix the cells at room temperature for 30 min, wash the cells with PBS a further three times.

Drop 1 μL of 50% glycerol PBS solution on a glass slide and then pick up the coverslip in a 24-well plate, mount the coverslip on the glycerol drop with the cells facing to the glass slide, fix the edges of coverslip with glass slide using nail enamel.
